{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue from string to float
sales_df['revenue'] = pd.to_numeric(sales_df['revenue'], errors='coerce')

# Filter for completed orders only (exclude refunded)
completed_orders = sales_df[sales_df['status'] == 'completed']

# Stratify by customer_segment and compute conversion rates within each segment
stratified_rates = completed_orders.groupby(['channel', 'customer_segment'])['converted'].agg(['mean', 'count']).reset_index()

# Compute weighted average conversion rates by channel, weighted by segment size
channel_totals = completed_orders.groupby('channel')['customer_segment'].value_counts().groupby('channel').sum()

weighted_email = 0
weighted_paid_search = 0

for segment in ['loyal', 'new', 'returning']:
    email_rate = stratified_rates[(stratified_rates['channel'] == 'email') & (stratified_rates['customer_segment'] == segment)]['mean'].values[0]
    paid_search_rate = stratified_rates[(stratified_rates['channel'] == 'paid_search') & (stratified_rates['customer_segment'] == segment)]['mean'].values[0]
    
    email_weight = stratified_rates[(stratified_rates['channel'] == 'email') & (stratified_rates['customer_segment'] == segment)]['count'].values[0] / channel_totals['email']
    paid_search_weight = stratified_rates[(stratified_rates['channel'] == 'paid_search') & (stratified_rates['customer_segment'] == segment)]['count'].values[0] / channel_totals['paid_search']
    
    weighted_email += email_rate * email_weight
    weighted_paid_search += paid_search_rate * paid_search_weight

# Compute the adjusted effect
adjusted_effect = weighted_email - weighted_paid_search

print(f"Stratified conversion rates by channel and segment:")
print(stratified_rates)
print(f"\nWeighted average email conversion rate: {weighted_email:.4f}")
print(f"Weighted average paid search conversion rate: {weighted_paid_search:.4f}")
print(f"Adjusted effect (email - paid_search): {adjusted_effect:.4f}")"}
